description: This file defines the Map.BoxZoom handler for Leaflet, enabling shift-drag zoom interaction on the map, including event handling, UI updates, and bounds fitting.

classes.name: BoxZoom
classes.description: Handler class for shift-drag box zoom interaction on the map.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the BoxZoom handler with the map instance.

methods.name: addHooks
methods.description: Adds event listeners for mousedown to start box zoom.

methods.name: moved
methods.description: Returns whether the box has been moved during interaction.

methods.name: _destroy
methods.description: Cleans up DOM elements related to the box zoom.

methods.name: _onMouseDown
methods.description: Handles mousedown event to initiate box zoom.

methods.name: _onMouseMove
methods.description: Handles mouse move to draw the zoom box.

methods.name: _finish
methods.description: Completes the box zoom interaction, removing UI elements.

methods.name: _onMouseUp
methods.description: Handles mouse up to finalize zoom and fit bounds.

methods.name: _onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles keydown event to cancel zoom on ESC.
